stories.title: Board Certification Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and standardize the internal schema for board certification signals including certification_status (certified/not_certified/unknown), board_name, specialty, certification_date (if available), and verification_source=NPI; ensure compatibility with provider_detail_service output structure.

stories.title: Board Certification Extraction Logic
stories.description: Implement parsing logic over NPI registry response to extract certification signals from taxonomy codes, credential strings, and enumeration data; normalize inconsistent formats and handle absence of explicit certification fields.

stories.title: Certification Scoring and Classification
stories.description: Implement deterministic classification logic to assign certification_status based on extracted signals, including explicit handling for conflicting credentials, multiple specialties, and incomplete NPI data.

stories.title: Evaluation API Integration
stories.description: Integrate board certification output into EvaluateCare facade response, ensuring the certification schema is consistently exposed alongside other provider evaluation attributes.

stories.title: Board Certification Tests and Integration Validation
stories.description: Develop unit tests for extraction and classification logic using mocked NPI responses (including edge cases: missing credentials, multiple taxonomies, ambiguous data) and integration tests validating end-to-end propagation through EvaluateCare facade.
